clip_texts: SC-04 Spurious obstacle with a road user following

Spray, steam, blowing debris or a soiled sensor produces a false obstacle in the path while a car or motorcycle follows
closely, possibly with an unbelted passenger

One concrete scenario (seeded sample of the logical
scenario)
ODD-20 Ego speed: 15.1 km/h (range 0 to 48 km/h)
ODD-10 Precipitation: 0.5 mm/h (range 0 to 2.5 mm/h)
ODD-11 Visibility: 200 m (the stated bound)
ODD-13 Road surface condition: wet
ODD-16 Traffic participants: car

Gap of the following road user: Bound stated by FSR-06.01, not yet
fixed; the motion drawn is choreography

Ego slows at 3 m/s², the firm level of FSR-03.02 (DQ-019, DQ-033);
choreography, not Autoware's planned braking
Safety goals at stake

SG-02 (ASIL D): Decelerate at least as much as needed to avoid a
collision the planned trajectory avoids
SG-03 (ASIL C): Avoid unintended hard deceleration
Pass criterion

Braking that the safety channel does not confirm stays at or below
the firm level; emergency braking happens only when a road user is
confirmed; a blocked safety sensor is detected and Autoware stops
comfortably; the belt warning acts (FSR-03.01, FSR-03.02,
FSR-03.03, FSR-02.01, FSR-07.08, FM-10, HR-03, AC-02)
Autoware's planned path (EL-01 Autoware computer, rated QM)
Safety monitor's envelope (EL-02, ASIL D); length not computed: the vehicle is not chosen yet (DQ-008)
Meant to do: no hard brake for an unconfirmed object
Dashed green: the path the pass criterion asks of the vehicle

Where the hazard lies: HE-03.1 Brakes hard for no reason with a vehicle or motorcycle following; HE-03.2 Brakes hard for no reason while a passenger is
unbelted (foreseeable misuse)
Amber, ringed: the road user the scenario is about
QUALITATIVE ILLUSTRATION · NOT A SIMULATION RESULT · DRAFT FOR ENGINEERING REVIEW
